entities.name: Katrīna Amerika
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Katrīna Amerika is a Latvian chess player who holds the FIDE title of Woman International Master (2009). She shared third place in the European Girls Under-12 Championship in 2003. She won the Latvian Chess Championship for women in 2014, and finished second in 2011, and 2013, and third on three occasions.
